description: Merge runtime configuration into a Thalovant runtime group. The SDK reads and deep-merges config, then writes with a revision precondition. Only explicit HTTP 412 conflicts retry, at most three attempts; older APIs fail before a write. Set merge=false for explicit unconditional replacement. personas, when provided, is REPLACED wholesale rather than merged; omit it to leave stored personas untouched. Requires hubs:read and paid hubs:write for merging; replacement needs paid hubs:write.

apiUrl.description: Control-plane base URL. Configured credentials may only be used on their configured origin; defaults to https://api.thalovant.com.

config.description: Configuration object merged into the stored configuration. Required.

loginScope.description: Optional login scope used with THALOVANT_EMAIL and THALOVANT_PASSWORD.

merge.description: False explicitly replaces the full configuration without a revision precondition.

personas.description: Replaces the stored personas outright. Left untouched when omitted.

name: thalovant_update_runtime_group_config
title: Update Runtime Group Config
